bullets.text: Telco AI Startups Surge - **Telco AI** market projected to grow from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
Diverging 5G Strategies - **AT&T**, **Verizon**, and **T-Mobile** adopt distinct approaches to 5G infrastructure.
HCLTech Acquires HPE Unit - **HCLTech** purchases **HPE's** Telco Solutions for up to $160 million, focusing on AI-driven automation.
AI and Wi-Fi Convergence - AI will transform **Wi-Fi** networks, enhancing management and user experiences by 2026.
6G's Intelligent Future - **6G** will embed intelligence directly into the radio layer, reshaping network operations.
Huawei's Agentic AI Vision - **Huawei** emphasizes AI agents for operational efficiency and new revenue streams in telecom.
Activation Over Infrastructure - Focus shifts from 'homes passed' to network activation and customer experience.
Geospatial Analytics Revolution - **Geospatial** data enhances network planning and customer insights for telecom operators.
AI Infrastructure Demands - By 2026, intelligent network design will be crucial for AI performance and security.
Mobile Core Transformation - AI, edge access, and disaster protection will redefine the mobile core by 2026.
